🎭 IMPOSTOR – Trust No One!
Get ready for a thrilling party game of secrets, clever clues, and hidden identities! Impostor is an exciting offline multiplayer game where everyone receives a secret role, but one or more players are impostors who don't know the secret word. Can you blend in, outsmart your friends, and uncover the impostors before they fool the entire group?

🎯 Objective
The crew must identify the hidden impostors through clever clues and careful voting. Meanwhile, impostors must listen closely, blend into the conversation, and avoid being exposed. Read between the lines, trust your instincts, and discover who is hiding the truth!

🎮 How to Play
• Set Up Your Party: Choose 3–10 players, enter unique player names, and select the maximum number of impostors.
• Choose Categories: Pick from a wide variety of word categories, including animals, movies, sports, technology, Indian culture, food, science, and more.
• Reveal Your Role: Pass the device around so each player can privately discover their role. Crew members see the secret word, while impostors must figure it out without revealing themselves.
• Discuss & Give Clues: Take turns sharing clues related to the secret word without saying it directly. Impostors must try to fit in!
• Vote & Expose: Everyone votes for the player they suspect. Discover who received the most votes and reveal the hidden impostors.
• Keep the Party Going: Play another round and track crew and impostor wins on the party scoreboard.

🕵️ Hidden Impostor Challenge
Every round brings a new secret word and a fresh mystery. The crew must give clues that prove they know the word without making it too obvious. Impostors must pay attention, think quickly, and act naturally to avoid suspicion. One suspicious clue could change the entire game!

📚 Exciting Word Categories
Explore a diverse collection of categories, including animals, books, famous people, games, movies and TV, music, professions, sports, technology, vehicles, superheroes, video games, anime, space and science, Indian food, Indian festivals, monuments, cities, mythology, and much more. Select your favourite categories or mix them all for unpredictable rounds!

🚀 Amazing Features
• Offline Party Fun: Play together on one device without requiring an internet connection.
• 3–10 Players: Bring your friends and family into the mystery.
• Hidden Roles: Secretly assign crew and impostor roles each round.
• Custom Player Names: Personalize your party with unique names.
• Adjustable Impostor Count: Allow one or up to two impostors per round.
• Private Role Reveal: Keep each player's identity hidden with a pass-the-device system.
• Flexible Categories: Select all word categories or choose specific favourites.
• Custom Discussion: Choose between one, two, or three clue rounds.
• Interactive Voting: Let every player vote for the suspected impostor.
• Party Scoreboard: Track crew and impostor victories across rounds.
• Auto-Saved Settings: Remember your setup preferences on the same device and browser.
• Mobile-Friendly Design: Enjoy a responsive interface on mobile phones, tablets, and computers.

🕹️ Controls
Mobile: Tap buttons, select categories, enter player names, reveal roles, and cast votes using the touchscreen.
PC: Use your mouse to navigate menus, choose settings, reveal roles, and vote. Use your keyboard to enter player names.

💡 Tips & Strategies
• Choose clues carefully: Give enough information to prove you know the word without revealing it directly.
• Watch for suspicious answers: Pay attention to clues that seem vague, unusual, or unrelated.
• Stay calm as an impostor: Listen to other players and avoid copying their clues too obviously.
• Think before voting: Consider everyone's clues instead of making a rushed decision.
• Mix up categories: Use different word categories to keep every new round surprising.

🌟 Why You'll Love IMPOSTOR
Whether you're hosting a game night, hanging out with friends, or looking for a fun group challenge, IMPOSTOR turns simple words into an exciting battle of observation, creativity, and deception. Every round creates new suspicions, unexpected twists, and memorable moments. No downloads, no complicated setup—just one device, a group of players, and a mystery waiting to be solved!

Can your team uncover the truth, or will the impostor fool everyone? Start your party and find out!
